title: Exceptional transport system adjunction law
statement:
theorem exists_exceptional_transport_core_system_adjunction_law
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l,
      LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s))
    (d : TransportCoreData l Ω D hl c operation left) :
    Nonempty (∀ E : FieldStage.{u} l,
      (operation (.integral E)).adjunction =
        ((PurReconstruction.realizedAdjunction (d.reconstruction E true).equivalence
          (d.reconstruction E false).equivalence (d.adjunction E)).ofNatIsoLeft
          (d.realizeF E).symm).ofNatIsoRight (d.realizeG E).symm)

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: conjugation yields the adjunction equality only for the right-adjoint uniqueness comparison. The supplied TransportCoreData leaves realizeG independent of the adjunction and realizeF. The canonical-comparison node proves the exact iff and the normalized construction; the obstruction node proves that a nonidentity twist rules out the asserted law for every datum. Thus the original universal step is invalid as stated, and the unchanged theorem is not claimed proved.
